description:
Create a Load Balancer

Creates a Load Balancer.

#### Operation specific errors

| Status | Code | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `412` | `source_port_already_used` | The source port you are trying to add is already in use |
| `412` | `primary_ip_version_mismatch` | The specified Primary IP has the wrong IP version |
| `422` | `ip_not_owned` | The IP is not owned by the owner of the project of the Load Balancer |
| `422` | `load_balancer_not_attached_to_network` | The Load Balancer is not attached to a network |
| `422` | `resolve_cloud_private_targets_error` | The server you are trying to add as a target is not attached to the same network as the Load Balancer |
| `422` | `resolve_cloud_public_targets_error` | The server that you are trying to add as a public target does not have a public IPv4 address |
| `422` | `target_already_defined` | The Load Balancer target you are trying to define is already defined |
| `422` | `primary_ip_assigned` | The specified Primary IP is already assigned to a resource |
| `422` | `primary_ip_blocked` | The specified Primary IP is blocked |
| `422` | `primary_ip_location_mismatch` | The specified Primary IP is bound to a different Location than the Load Balancer |

labels.description:
User-defined labels (`key/value` pairs) for the Resource.
For more information, see "[Labels](#description/labels)".

load_balancer_type.description: ID or name of the Load Balancer type this Load Balancer should be created with.

location.description: ID or name of Location to create Load Balancer in.

network.description: ID of the network the Load Balancer should be attached to on creation.

public_interface.description: Enable or disable the public interface of the Load Balancer.

public_net.description:
Public network options of the Load Balancer.

Only allowed if the public interface is enabled.

ipv4.description:
ID of an existing [Primary IP](#tag/primary-ips) of type `ipv4` to assign to the Load Balancer.

The [Primary IP](#tag/primary-ips) must be unassigned, must not be blocked and must be bound to the
same Location as the Load Balancer.

Omit or set to `null` to get a system managed IP address instead. System managed IP addresses are
not [Primary IPs](#tag/primary-ips) and are created and deleted together with the Load Balancer.

ipv6.description:
ID of an existing [Primary IP](#tag/primary-ips) of type `ipv6` to assign to the Load Balancer.

The [Primary IP](#tag/primary-ips) must be unassigned, must not be blocked and must be bound to the
same Location as the Load Balancer.

Omit or set to `null` to get a system managed IP address instead. System managed IP addresses are
not [Primary IPs](#tag/primary-ips) and are created and deleted together with the Load Balancer.

ip.description: Configuration for an IP target. It is only possible to use the (Public or vSwitch) IPs of Hetzner Online Root Servers belonging to the project owner. IPs belonging to other users are blocked. Additionally IPs belonging to services provided by Hetzner Cloud (Servers, Load Balancers, ...) are blocked as well. Only valid and required if type is `ip`.
IP of a server that belongs to the same customer (public IPv4/IPv6) or private IP in a subnet type vswitch.

server.description: Configuration for type Server, only valid and required if type is `server`.

ip.description:
Optional public IP of the Server to use as target.
Must be the Primary IPv4 of the Server, or an IPv6 host address within IPv6 /64 subnet of the Server. If omitted, the Primary IPv4 of the Server is used. Must not be a private IP and is only valid for public targets.

use_private_ip.description: Use the private network IP instead of the public IP of the Server, requires the Server and Load Balancer to be in the same network. Only valid for target types `server` and `label_selector`.
